Name: Silver's Farmer Girl (CP and FS)
Author: SilverTinyFox
Description:
I wanted to change a few animations from the vanilla farmer and got a little too carried away with modifying the base. At some point, I simply decided to make her completely different from vanilla and ended up like that. After a few adaptations [s](like making her 1px shorter in side view to fit the shirts)[/s], I finally ended up with a playable version! This mod [i][color=#d5a6bd]heavily [/color]changes the farmer girl body[/i], so not all clothing mods may really fit, but most of [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/luoli1119/mods?gameId=1303]luoli[/url]'s clothes for Fashion Sense and other mods that add skirts and shorter shirts like in luoli's seems to work pretty fine with it, imo. Anyway, hope you enjoy!
[center][b]Now with fashion sense version![/b][/center][center][b][color=#ff0000]
Hey, I only upload my mods on nexus! Don't download it anywhere else, okay??[/color][/b][/center][b]
[size=2]If you enjoy my work and want to give me some support, consider [url=https://ko-fi.com/silvertinyfox]buying me a coffee![/url]
[/size][color=#c27ba0]
Config Guide (CP only):
[/color][/b][i]Recomended using [/i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url][i] for easier config[/i]
[b]
Options:[/b]
[list]
[*][u]Head Type [/u]- base, vanillaHead. The head type. Base is the main one and vanillaHead is a vanillaesque version, made to fit hair, accessories and hats mods.
[*][u]Modded Shirts[/u] - vanilla, alt, false. Makes the shirts fit the body. [i][color=#d5a6bd]Note: the "alt" only has 3 shirts as of now (the rest is copy paste from vanilla fixed to not be so empty). I'll prioritize finishing the vanilla clothes  before making my own version of them [i](only the first 52 shirts are done. Still a long way to go~)[/i]. Set to "false" if you don't want the clothes to fit the body (if you're using some other mod, idk), but it will look weird.[/color][/i]
[*][u]Modded Pants[/u] - vanilla, paler, false. Pants fit the body. Paler makes the pants slightly paler than vanilla. [i][color=#d5a6bd]Note: Only the 4 pants from character creation are complete right now for both options.[/color][/i]
[*][u]Modded Hats[/u][b]﻿ [/b]- true, false. Makes the hats fit the body. Only works/is needed for the base head option.
[*][u]Modded Accessories[/u] - vanilla, alt, false. Makes the accessories fit the body. [i][color=#d5a6bd]Note: the "alt" version only changes two accessories for now. In the future I may add a few more as I see fit. [/color][color=#00ffff] [/color]done in 1.0.1[/i]
[*][u]Modded Hair[/u] - true, false. Makes the hair fit the body. Only works/is needed for the base head option.
[*][u]Modded Hair2[/u] - vanilla, silverEars, silver, false. Makes the hairstyles2 fit the body and optionally changes hair 58 with Silver's own hair (made this for myself, but you can use it if you like) with or without the elf ears (base head only). [i][color=#d5a6bd]Note: silverEars adds the Silver's elf ears with earings on hair 58 with my hair (same from pfp), but only works with skin 24 (it uses the colors of skin 24, so it will look strange in any other option), since it's the one I'm using. I may add the ears as a FS pack (fitting any skin colors, including modded ones) if there's demand or I just feel like so. There's a lot of FS packs with cute elf ears already, so idk.[/color][/i]
[*][u]Sleeves Type[/u] - none, long, oversized, bigS. Which sleeve to use. [i][color=#d5a6bd]Note: If you wish for a seasonal change, I recommend using GMCM to change it manually when you arrive at said season. I couldn't figure a way for it to not bug colors when using fashion sense and dynamically modifying the sleeves, so that's how I solved it, lol.[/color][/i]
[/list]
[color=#c27ba0][size=3][b]Installation Guide:
[/b][/size][/color][color=#d5a6bd][size=2][b]CP version:[/b]
[/size][/color]Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7517]Custom Tokens[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] ([i]optional but recommended!) [/i]and extract then into your mods folder.
Download and extract this mod into your mods folder.
Enjoy!

[b][color=#d5a6bd][size=2]FS version:
[/size][/color][/b]Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url] and extract into your mods folder.
Download and extract the FS version of this mod (it's in optional files).
Enjoy!﻿

[color=#c27ba0][size=3][b]Compatibility:
[/b][/size][/color][i]Other CP mods that change the farmer girl base[/i]:[u] not compatible[/u]. This mod changes the farmer girl base, so it won't work with other mods that also do this. I think it's okay for the farmer boy, but turn the modded shirts off or there will be bugs on the farmer boy.
[i]Fashion Sense: [/i][u]Compatible[/u]. I always use my mod with FS, so I made sure it wouldn't bug while using it. If you find any bugs, please tell me. Just remember that some hair, hats and accessories might look a little tall in side view because of the farmer being shorter. I'll probably make a config option with normal sized head so she won't be shorter in side view anymore, later on.
[i]Shirts, pants, hats, accessories non-FS mods: [/i][u]Technically compatible[/u], but expect visual bugs if the mods aren't made for this body, mainly for pants and side view. If you're using CP mods that change the clothes, you can test it and see if it's not weird, but turn off the modded shirts, pants and whatever you're using if doing so.

If you're confused about compatibility with anything else that I didn't remember to specify here, do tell me, please!

[color=#c27ba0][b][size=3]FS Version Quick Use Guide:
[/size][/b][/color]Once in game, use the hand mirror from Fashion Sense and change the body to Silver's Body or Silver's Body (nose). It will be with no shoes or arms. Change the shoes to SB Boots and the sleeves to one of the SB types (SB BigS, SB Long and so on, they're the same from the CP version for now + a small edited one).
Done. You can customize the skin, eyes and eyebrows colors using the arrows beside the color sliders to change which layer you're coloring!
[b][i]Note: The FS version fixes the issue where modded hairs, acc and hats are taller than player head.

[/i][/b][size=3][b][color=#c27ba0]Know bugs:
[/color][/b][/size]The FS version has a small visual bug with the closed eyes not being colored properly when relaxing in the spa. This seens to be something with Fashion Sense itself, from my tests, so for now I can't do anything about it. Any bug reports here related to this issue will be deleted.
